metaDescription: Order custom CNB shorts in bulk for your team or event. Perfect Imprints offers quality decoration. Get a quote today!
introHtml: CNB shorts offer a reliable, consistent fit for teams, staff, and events. With a range of styles from joggers to compression shorts, CNB provides durable fabrics that hold up to repeated wear and washing. Bulk buyers can choose screen printing or embroidery for a clean, professional look that stays vibrant season after season.
